error.dns: Cannot find the host {host}. Check the name or your network.
error.refused: Nothing is listening on {host}:{port}. Is the broker running on that port?
error.timeout: No answer from {host}:{port} after {seconds} s. A firewall may be blocking the port.
error.tlsOnPlain: {host}:{port} did not start TLS. Try mqtt:// instead of mqtts://, or the broker's TLS port.
error.closed: {host}:{port} closed the connection before the broker answered.
error.network: The network connection to {host}:{port} failed. Check the network and try again.
error.badLogin: The broker refused the login for user {user} (bad username or password). Reason code {code}.
error.badLoginAnonymous: The broker requires a username and password. Reason code {code}.
error.notAuthorized: The broker does not allow this client to connect (not authorized). Reason code {code}.
error.clientIdRejected: The broker rejected the client ID {clientId}. Choose another one, or use Random. Reason code {code}.
error.serverUnavailable: The broker is up but not accepting connections right now. Reason code {code}.
error.protocolVersion: This broker does not speak MQTT 5. Set the version to 3.1.1 or auto.
error.connackOther: The broker refused the connection: {reason}. Reason code {code}.
error.packetTooLarge: This broker accepts at most {size} per message.
error.wsHandshake: The broker closed the WebSocket: path {path} not accepted (HTTP {status}).
error.wsProtocol: The broker refused the WebSocket (HTTP {status}). Check the path and that the port serves MQTT over WebSocket.
error.notConnected: This connection is not open. Connect first.
error.protocol: The broker sent something MQTT Panel did not understand. Check that the port serves MQTT.
error.internal: MQTT Panel hit an internal problem ({detail}). Please report it.
reason.sessionTakenOver: session taken over by another client with the same ID
tls.untrusted: This broker presents a certificate MQTT Panel cannot verify.
tls.reason.selfSigned: Reason: the certificate is self-signed. Nobody vouches for it, so compare the fingerprint with the one shown on the broker before trusting it.
tls.reason.unknownCa: Reason: the certificate is signed by an authority this computer does not know ({issuer}). Compare the fingerprint with the one shown on the broker before trusting it.
tls.reason.fingerprintChanged: The broker now presents a different certificate from the one you trusted. Old fingerprint {old}, new fingerprint {new}.
tls.notYetValid: The broker's certificate is not valid before {date}. Check the clock on the broker or this computer.
tls.wrongName: The certificate is for {names}, not {host}. If you reach the broker through an alias, set Server name (SNI).
tls.missingIntermediate: The broker did not send its intermediate certificate (issuer {issuer}). Ask the broker owner to include the chain, or add the intermediate under CA certificate.
tls.clientCertRequired: The broker requires a client certificate and none is set in this profile.
tls.clientCertRejected: The broker rejected the client certificate (not issued by a CA it trusts).
tls.clientCertRevoked: The broker rejected the client certificate {name} (revoked).
tls.handshakeAlpn: The broker closed the TLS handshake; it may require a Protocol tag (ALPN) such as mqtt.
tls.keyMismatch: The client key does not belong to the client certificate.
tls.trustScopeCert: This certificate only, for the profile "{profile}". If the broker presents a different one, you are asked again.
tls.trustScopeCa: Future certificates from this CA too.
file.notCertificate: This file is not a certificate.
file.notKey: This file is not a private key.
file.notPkcs12: This file is not a PKCS#12 bundle.
file.notProto: This file is not a Protobuf schema: {detail}
file.notCsr: This file is not a certificate request (CSR).
file.unknownImport: This file is not a connection export MQTT Panel can read.
import.passwordsSkipped: Passwords and keys were not imported. Enter them in each profile.
payload.invalidHex: Invalid hex at position {position}. Use pairs of 0-9 and A-F; spaces and 0x are allowed.
decode.notImage: This payload is not an image MQTT Panel can show.
request.needsMqtt5: Request and response needs MQTT 5; this broker negotiated 3.1.1.
request.wrongCorrelation: Ignored a reply on {topic} with correlation {correlation}: it does not match any request.
broker.portPrivileged: Ports below 1024 need administrator rights; choose 1024 or higher.
broker.portInUseBy: Port {port} is already in use by {process}.
broker.listenerFailed: The {kind} listener on port {port} could not start: {detail}
broker.userInvalid: A username cannot be empty or contain spaces.
broker.certExists: A client certificate named {name} already exists.
broker.nameInvalid: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores for the name.
broker.noListener: No listener is enabled. Turn one on first.
broker.notRunning: The broker is not running. Start it first.
keychain.unavailable: The system keychain is not available: {detail}
profile.noSubscriptions: No subscriptions: you will see nothing until you add one.
cli.profileNotFound: No saved profile named {name}. Run mqttpanel profiles list to see them.
cli.noPayload: Give a payload with -m, --file or --stdin, or use --delete-retained.
error.publishRefused: The broker refused the message: {reason}. Reason code {code}.
